title: A smoother start. Fewer interruptions.
summary: Get to know PostPlus on first install, connect your account from a browser, and keep working through updates when it is safe to continue.
highlights: First-time installation includes a concise product introduction; later updates show release-specific changes without repeating the welcome.
Compatible updates can resume the original command once. If new agent instructions are required or verification fails, PostPlus explains why it stopped.
Login opens your browser by default and keeps a clickable link available. Connect once; the CLI confirms success only after saving and validating the connection.
Insufficient-credit errors include the relevant personal or team billing link, with agent guidance to resume existing work rather than blindly submit it again.
Safer concurrent updates and credential saving, with Windows npm command handling that preserves arguments and reports failures clearly.
Agents can correct an unambiguous local command mistake once before remote work starts; generated examples use supported command arguments.
